result.summary: The page is mostly rendered correctly, but there is one clear visual defect: on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, the metadata line has two text items drawn on top of each other, making the delivery time and delivery fee unreadable. The partially visible carousel item and the bottom-cropped card are expected scrolling behaviour and are not reported.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section, the metadata row under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' has overlapping text: the delivery time (e.g. '25–35 min') and the delivery fee text ('€0 delivery') are rendered on top of each other, producing garbled text like '25–3€0 delivery'. Only the trailing '• Ramen' is legible.
issues.suggestion: Lay out the metadata items in a row with proper spacing and separators (e.g. '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen'). Check for absolute positioning, negative margins, or a missing flex gap/width on the time and delivery-fee elements so they do not occupy the same horizontal space.
